[USER] User is interested in how emerging technologies such as blockchain and IoT are leveraged in supply chain management.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Emerging technologies like blockchain and IoT are revolutionizing supply chain management by addressing challenges such as transparency, efficiency, and traceability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Blockchain technology is used for enhanced transparency and traceability in supply chains, creating a tamper-proof record of transactions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] IoT devices, sensors, and RFID tags are used for better supply chain visibility, allowing real-time tracking of goods and monitoring of conditions affecting quality.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Blockchain and IoT improve supply chain sustainability by tracking the origin of raw materials and monitoring energy and water usage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Blockchain and IoT improve supply chain efficiency through automation and digitization, reducing manual errors and costs.  
[USER] User finds the information about technology in supply chain management interesting.  
[USER] User inquires about companies using blockchain and IoT in their supply chains.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Walmart uses blockchain technology to track the origin of food products for improved traceability and safety.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Coca-Cola uses blockchain to track the production and delivery of bottling equipment, enhancing transparency and reducing costs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] IBM and Maersk developed a blockchain-based platform called TradeLens to connect players in the global shipping industry, improving visibility and reducing paperwork.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Nestle uses IoT sensors to monitor the quality and safety of products during transportation and storage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provenance is a blockchain-based platform that allows consumers to trace the origin of products, increasing transparency and trust.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] More companies are expected to adopt blockchain and IoT technologies in the coming years for improved efficiency, transparency, and sustainability.
